patches.name: Disable in-app browser
patches.description: Opens links in the phone's default browser instead of Facebook Lite's built-in browser.

patches.name: Hide sponsored posts
patches.description: Hides sponsored posts in the news feed and removes sponsored reels as they load.

patches.name: Install beside Meta's apps
patches.description: Lets the patched app install while Facebook, Messenger or other Meta apps are installed, by renaming the permissions it shares with them.

patches.name: Morphe settings
patches.description: Adds a settings screen to the app icon's long-press menu, with a font size slider.

patches.name: Use system font
patches.description: Blocks the downloaded Meta fonts (Optimistic, Instagram Sans, emoji, ...) so the app falls back to the system font.

patches.name: Use system font in feed
patches.description: Draws feed text with the system font instead of the font the server sends.

patches.name: Video download and auto next reel
patches.description: Adds a button to download the playing video in HD or SD (you choose the quality), and moves to the next reel when one ends. These are switched in the Morphe settings screen.
